original_publisher: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR)
supporting_passage: Apply 60 kg Nitrogen, 24 kg Phosphorus (P2O5), and 24 kg Potassium (K2O). Split nitrogen into 3 equal top-dressings.

question_text: వరిలో నత్రజని, భాస్వరం, పొటాష్ ఎరువులు ఎలా వేయాలి?

question_text: Why and when is gypsum application critical for groundnut? Please explain recommended practice.
